decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent digital automation add-on in a strategic monitoring area, it is likely to be retained because results are still early and the firm's R&D capability and product breadth give it enough slack to wait for municipal and utility adoption.

The web tool fits the engineering offer but is easier to redeploy or discontinue if usage falls short of aspirations, so its drop risk is somewhat higher even though the firm would usually keep such a recent product for another trial period.

This product is closely aligned with the firm's established systems business and future direction toward intelligent infrastructure control, so under bounded rationality management would likely continue it unless clear underperformance quickly emerges.
